summary: A framework for using transcoding services in SIP sessions, such as converting between audio codecs or between text and speech. It covers how to discover that a session needs transcoding and how to invoke it, using either a conference bridge or third-party call control. It was motivated by the needs of deaf, hard of hearing, and speech-impaired users. This is an informational document.

eli5.summary: Two people speak different languages, so you bring in a helper who sits in the middle and translates both ways. This memo explains how phone systems find and call in such a helper.

questions: sip transcoding for deaf and hard of hearing users
conference bridge versus third-party call control transcoding
